Value bukan sekadar audience besar; premium context, relevance, attention, and commercial guarantee juga penting.

learning_objective: RFP/RFQ mengubah kebutuhan media menjadi permintaan proposal atau quotation yang dapat dibandingkan. Dokumen harus menetapkan objective, target, geography, dates, format, deliverables, KPI, audience requirement, budget range, measurement, brand safety, and commercial terms. Proposal review memeriksa completeness, assumptions, exclusions, rate basis, bonus, agency fee, production, data/measurement cost, and cancellation policy.
mapped_learning_resources: Bisnis Indonesia — Rate Card 2026 / Media Order requirements — https://cdn.bisnis.com/bisnis-web/assets/advertise-with-us/2026/Rate-Card-2026-Harian-Bisnis-Indonesia.pdf?id=ff28ea7963672966e0820fa11b084ac7c62d14d7615794299d65bbce7e6b10c1 ; Bisnis.com — Regional Rate Card 2026 / Media Order and cancellation terms — https://cdn.bisnis.com/bisnis-web/assets/advertise-with-us/2026/Rate-Card-2026-Regional-Bisnis.com.pdf

learning_objective: Commercial benchmarking membandingkan cost dan value menggunakan unit yang disamakan. CPM, CPP, cost per unique reach, sponsorship rate, package pricing, discount, and added value harus memiliki target universe, dates, format, geography, and delivery definitions yang jelas. Historical rate bukan otomatis market benchmark terkini. Buyer perlu menyimpan source, date, volume tier, currency, and negotiation condition.
mapped_learning_resources: Bisnis Indonesia — Rate Card 2026 — https://cdn.bisnis.com/bisnis-web/assets/advertise-with-us/2026/Rate-Card-2026-Harian-Bisnis-Indonesia.pdf?id=ff28ea7963672966e0820fa11b084ac7c62d14d7615794299d65bbce7e6b10c1 ; Media Indonesia — Rate Card 2025 (historical comparator only) — https://mediaindonesia.com/template/layanan-bisnis/rate_card_mi.html ; MRC — media-rating research standards — https://www.mediaratingcouncil.org/standards-and-guidelines

required_next_verification: Build a normalized workbook from current written quotes with matching format, placement, target, time window, denominator, guaranteed vs bonus volume, currency, tax, production and third-party fees.

chapter_title: Media Booking, Insertion Order & Contract Terms
learning_objective: Insertion Order dan kontrak mengikat scope media buying menjadi komitmen komersial. IO perlu advertiser, publisher, placement, format, dates, quantity, rate, cost, currency, tax, cancellation, creative deadline, tracking, reporting, payment, and sign-off. Legal terms dapat meliputi indemnity, privacy, IP, liability, exclusivity, makegood, force majeure, and termination; buyer bukan pengganti legal counsel tetapi harus mengenali escalation points.
mapped_learning_resources: Bisnis Indonesia — Rate Card 2026 / Media Order, deadlines and cancellation — https://cdn.bisnis.com/bisnis-web/assets/advertise-with-us/2026/Rate-Card-2026-Harian-Bisnis-Indonesia.pdf?id=ff28ea7963672966e0820fa11b084ac7c62d14d7615794299d65bbce7e6b10c1 ; Bisnis.com — Regional Rate Card 2026 / Media Order terms — https://cdn.bisnis.com/bisnis-web/assets/advertise-with-us/2026/Rate-Card-2026-Regional-Bisnis.com.pdf ; Google Ad Manager — About line items — https://support.google.com/admanager/answer/9405477?hl=en ; The Jakarta Post — historical publisher terms (10% VAT text is stale) — https://www.thejakartapost.com/content-funding-classifications

material_gap: A Media Order is not necessarily a universal Indonesian IO/advertising contract. Google is platform-specific. The Jakarta Post's 10% VAT wording is dated and not a current tax authority.
required_next_verification: Obtain current publisher-specific MO/IO, terms, amendments and signatory authority; review cancellation, makegood, IP, disclosure, privacy, payment, tax, dispute and precedence clauses.
reviewer_role: AI-assisted research desk review; independent human reviewer not assigned; SME approval open

chapter_title: Campaign Delivery, Proof of Performance & Makegoods
learning_objective: Delivery stewardship memastikan media owner memenuhi booking dan terms. Buyer memonitor booked vs delivered, dates, placements, creative, proof-of-posting/proof-of-play, audience, quality, and shortfall. Makegood bukan permintaan informal; ia mengikuti contract, tolerance, deadline, and evidence. Monitor campaign secara berkala agar masalah bisa diperbaiki sebelum end-of-flight.
mapped_learning_resources: Bisnis Indonesia — Rate Card 2026 / delivery, proof-retention and cancellation clauses — https://cdn.bisnis.com/bisnis-web/assets/advertise-with-us/2026/Rate-Card-2026-Harian-Bisnis-Indonesia.pdf?id=ff28ea7963672966e0820fa11b084ac7c62d14d7615794299d65bbce7e6b10c1 ; Google Ad Manager — About line items — https://support.google.com/admanager/answer/9405477?hl=en ; MRC — viewability, IVT and measurement standards index — https://www.mediaratingcouncil.org/standards-and-guidelines
source_evidence: Bisnis Indonesia's 2026 terms specify Media Order/material deadlines, written cancellation and one-month proof-ad retention. Google documents line-item settings; MRC provides separate measurement/verification guidance.
material_gap: Proof-ad retention is not a delivery guarantee, independent campaign report, viewability commitment or remedy. MRC standards do not create contractual makegood/refund rights.
required_next_verification: Require placement-level proof, publisher report, agreed counting/billable definition, third-party verification where contracted, shortfall tolerance, notice window and written remedy in the actual MO/IO.
reviewer_role: AI-assisted research desk review; independent human reviewer not assigned; SME approval open

learning_objective: Invoice reconciliation menghubungkan IO, vendor invoice, rate, volume, dates, placement, currency, tax, fees, discount, bonus, makegood, and proof. Buyer harus membedakan planned, contracted, delivered, and billable basis. Variance dapat berasal dari taxes, FX, cancellation, underdelivery, extra placement, or contract amendments. Semua adjustment harus memiliki evidence dan approver.
mapped_learning_resources: Kementerian Keuangan JDIH — PMK 131/2024 — https://jdih.kemenkeu.go.id/dok/pmk-131-tahun-2024 ; DJP — PER-1/PJ/2025 technical tax-invoice guidance — https://www.pajak.go.id/id/peraturan-7 ; Bisnis Indonesia — Rate Card 2026 (publisher's PPN statement; transaction-specific check required) — https://cdn.bisnis.com/bisnis-web/assets/advertise-with-us/2026/Rate-Card-2026-Harian-Bisnis-Indonesia.pdf?id=ff28ea7963672966e0820fa11b084ac7c62d14d7615794299d65bbce7e6b10c1 ; The Jakarta Post — historical 10% VAT wording; do not reuse — https://www.thejakartapost.com/content-funding-classifications
source_evidence: PMK 131/2024 is the VAT framework effective from 1 January 2025; DJP PER-1/PJ/2025 sets technical tax-invoice requirements. Bisnis Indonesia's 2026 card states its rates exclude PPN 11%, a publisher-specific statement.
material_gap: Tax treatment depends on supplier/customer status, service classification, taxable base and applicable provisions. The Jakarta Post's 10% wording is dated. Synthetic templates cannot approve real invoices.
required_next_verification: Match PO/MO, invoice, tax invoice, legal entity/NPWP, taxable base, service classification, discounts/fees and evidence; obtain finance/tax sign-off for the actual transaction before payment.
reviewer_role: AI-assisted research desk review; independent human reviewer not assigned; SME approval open

learning_objective: Investment evaluation menilai hasil pembelian dan hubungan media owner setelah campaign. Analisis mencakup cost, delivery, audience quality, placement, value-add, fees, makegood, effectiveness, and future leverage. Negosiasi berikutnya menggunakan evidence, bukan sekadar meminta discount. Buyer harus menyampaikan value story kepada planner/finance/client serta memisahkan hasil komersial dari performance campaign.

Track ini tidak mengajarkan DSP bidding sebagai kompetensi inti; direct publisher buying menjadi fokus, dengan auction/platform buying sebagai cross-track awareness.
